# form.addButton

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.10</span></div>

Add a button to the current form.

```lua
form.addButton(line, rect, params)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `params` | table | yes | see the fields below |

Fields of `params`:

- `text` (string): button labem
- `icon` (Mask): button bitmap
- `press` (function): the function which will be called on button press
- `options` (number): text flags like TEXT_LEFT, TEXT_CENTERED, etc.


## Returns

The new button

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addButton(line, nil, {text="Text Button", icon="", press=function() end})
```

- [widget-gauge](../../examples/official/widget-gauge.md)
